def: a reversal, i.e. the backside (of a gem), fold (of a double-leaved door), transmutation (of a name)
kjv: being changed, inclosed, be set, turning.

occurrences.text: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
And Nebo, and Baal–meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
